# Research program

> DEMO · 演示数据，非真实研究. Every number in this direction is synthetic.

## Direction
DEMO · 演示数据，非真实研究 · 隔夜跳空的延续效应（已结题）

## Data
- File: synthetic daily bars generated by the demo builder
- Instrument, bar size, period: DEMO-INDEX, daily, 2018-2024 (synthetic)
- Periods per year: 252

## Evaluator settings
- Costs: 5 bps per unit turnover
- Lockbox fraction: 0.2
- Validation fraction of the development data: 0.3, in-sample folds: 3

## Budget
- USD per direction: 40 (demo)

## Autonomy
- Autonomy: checkpoints

## Verdict thresholds
- supported: DSR >= 0.95, >= 2/3 of validation sub-periods positive, PBO <= 0.5, beats buy-and-hold
- refuted: out-of-sample Sharpe <= 0
- otherwise: inconclusive
